item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Security forces are conducting search operations in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch and Mendhar districts while an encounter in Kupwara's Keran sector killed two terrorists, and another infiltration attempt was foiled in the same district. In Manipur, fresh firing in Kamjong injured four civilians including a village chief, and a Kuki-Zo woman was killed and her husband wounded in an ambush by suspected Naga militants. The Indian Army and Assam Rifles are launching water-security and skill-development projects in Manipur, while apple cultivation is expanding at the expense of rice fields, raising food-security concerns. 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
